title: Carried clock under a uniform gradient and two clocks between two meetings

key_results.statement: Exact (weak records, long-chain limit): under $G=-\mathcal F\hat x$ the weight over the plane-wave label is translated rigidly, $p(\lambda)=p_0+\mathcal F\lambda$ (mod $2\pi$), with unchanged spread, for every $\mathcal F$.

The start stays in the positive branch if $\eta:=\mathcal F\tau/(4m^2)\ll1$; the neglected negative-branch weight of level $k$ is at most $(k\epsilon/4+2\eta)^2+O(\epsilon^3)$, of second order in $\epsilon$ at fixed $\mathcal F\lambda_0$.

$\Delta\bar x_1(\lambda)=\kappa\sigma_X\hat e\,[\bar\omega(p_0+\mathcal F\lambda)-\bar\omega(p_0)]/\mathcal F$ with $\bar\omega(p)=\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$, up to a remainder $\kappa\sigma_X(\tau^2\lambda/m)\,O(\epsilon^2+\delta p^2)$.

The oscillating part of the velocity contributes to the label displacement a bounded term of size at most $(\tau/m)[(N-1)\epsilon/4+\mathcal F\tau/(2m^2)]+O(\epsilon^2)$, of relative order $\epsilon^2$: nothing at first order.
$V_1(\lambda)=\kappa\sigma_X\,\bar w(p(\lambda))\,\hat e$ and $b(\lambda):=\lVert V_1\rVert/v_{\max}=\tau\lvert\sin p(\lambda)\cos p(\lambda)\rvert/\bar\omega(p(\lambda))$.

$q_1(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\vartheta_1(\lambda))+\mathcal R_1$ with $\mathcal R_1=O(\epsilon^2)+O(\delta p^2)+O(\kappa)$ at fixed $N$, $\tau/m$, $\lambda/\lambda_0$, $\mathcal F\lambda_0$: the form of (5.21) with the advance $\vartheta_1(\lambda)$.

Clock advance $\vartheta_1(\lambda)=\lambda_0^{-1}\int_0^\lambda\Gamma(p_0+\mathcal F\lambda')\,d\lambda'=[\mathcal I(p_0+\mathcal F\lambda)-\mathcal I(p_0)]/(\mathcal F\lambda_0)$, with $\mathcal I(\varphi)=\int_0^\varphi\bar\mu\,dp/\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$ an incomplete elliptic integral of the first kind.

$\lambda_0\,d\vartheta_1/d\lambda=\Gamma(p(\lambda))=\bar\mu/\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p(\lambda)}$: to first order in $\epsilon$, $\mathcal F$ enters the rate only through the plane-wave label at $\lambda$.

Without expansion in the label: $(\lambda_0\,d\vartheta_1/d\lambda)^2(1+\tau^2\sin^4p(\lambda)/\bar\mu^2)=1-\lVert V_1\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2$, equivalently $\lVert V_1\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2=(1-\Gamma^2)[1-\bar\mu^2(1-\Gamma^2)/(\tau^2\Gamma^2)]$ with $\Gamma=\lambda_0\,d\vartheta_1/d\lambda$.

$\vartheta_1(\lambda)=(1+\bar\rho)\,\lambda_0^{-1}\int_0^\lambda\sqrt{1-\lVert V_1(\lambda')\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2}\,d\lambda'$ with $-\tau^2\max\sin^4p(\lambda')/(2\bar\mu^2)\le\bar\rho\le0$; for small labels on the whole path, $\bar\rho\to0$.

The bodies meet at $\lambda>0$ iff $\mathcal F\lambda\in\{n\pi: n\ge1\}\cup\{2\lvert p_0\rvert+n\pi: n\ge0\}$; the first meeting is $\lambda_R=2\lvert p_0\rvert/\mathcal F$ for $p_0<0$ and $\lambda_R=\pi/\mathcal F$ for $p_0=0$.

For $p_0<0$: $\vartheta_2(\lambda_R)=2\lvert p_0\rvert/(\mathcal F\lambda_0)$, $\vartheta_1(\lambda_R)=2\mathcal I(\lvert p_0\rvert)/(\mathcal F\lambda_0)$, ratio $\mathcal I(\lvert p_0\rvert)/\lvert p_0\rvert$, independent of $\mathcal F$; for $p_0=0$ the ratio is $2\mathcal K/\pi$ with $\mathcal K=\mathcal I(\pi/2)$.

$\vartheta_1(\lambda)<\vartheta_2(\lambda)$ for every $\lambda>0$ and all admissible $p_0$, $\mathcal F>0$, $\tau>0$; at every meeting $2\mathcal K/\pi\le\vartheta_1/\vartheta_2<1$, so the clock of the body without gradient has advanced more and the advances are never equal.

$\vartheta_1(\lambda_R)/\vartheta_2(\lambda_R)=1-\tau^2p_0^2/(6\bar\mu^2)+O(p_0^4)=1-\tfrac12\langle\lVert V_1\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2\rangle+O(p_0^4)$, with the mean over $[0,\lambda_R]$ equal to $\tau^2p_0^2/(3\bar\mu^2)+O(p_0^4)$.

Both readings at $\lambda_R$ are certain up to $\mathcal R_1$ iff $\mathcal F\lambda_0=2\lvert p_0\rvert/n_2$ and $\mathcal I(\lvert p_0\rvert)/\lvert p_0\rvert=n_1/n_2$ with integers $1\le n_1<n_2$; clock 1 then shows $n_1\bmod N$ and clock 2 shows $n_2\bmod N$.

Velocity of body 1 along its path
Speed in units of the maximal speed

open_issues: The remainders of (9.7) and (9.11) are order estimates at fixed ℱλ; their constants were not computed, and nothing is claimed for ℱλ → ∞, where transfer to the negative branch may accumulate.
The explicit dependence of the clock rate on ℱ at second order, O(η²), is identified but not derived in full.

A meeting is an equality of mean positions only; λ_R is determined up to a relative shift of order (ε² + δp²) that is not uniform for p₀ → 0⁻, and the first meeting changes discontinuously between p₀ → 0⁻ and p₀ = 0.
Corrections in κ, including any influence of one body on the other through the medium, are out of scope; the results assume leading order in κ before the long-chain limit.
At fixed τ/μ̄ the small-label relation (9.15) does not distinguish the square root from 1 − b²/2 at leading order; the exact relation is (9.14).

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: labels, ℱλ, η, the advances and the speed ratio are pure numbers; V_1 and v_max have the same dimension.
τ → 0: the clock decouples exactly for every ℱ, both advances equal λ/λ₀, the displacement vanishes and the ratio of advances is 1.
